source: v93 kept a bounded shot task but still made no later shot. Default one-touch finisher mode holds a sampled joint pose for 0.30 seconds after contact; this may prevent the SONIC foundation from matching the moving ball.
hypothesis: Disabling only the one-touch frozen-pose finisher continuation keeps the live locomotion foundation available after measured receive contact, possibly improving balance and second-touch mobility.
gate: 3/3 six-body safe and clean foot transfer, zero nonfoot contacts, at least one later genuine finisher foot shot >=2 m/s; if not, reject frozen-pose removal as a standalone improvement.
interpretation: Teacher ablation is a consumed SIM_ONLY diagnostic, not a learned replacement. Any success requires a new held-out local exam and 4v4 match exam.
